BEFORE YOU PAY

  • Don’t pay a deposit or rent before you have seen the room, in person or on a live video call.
  • Check who you are dealing with: ask for ID and confirm they live there or hold the lease.
  • Ask whether the lease allows subletting, and get that permission in writing.
  • Get a written agreement with the dates, rent, deposit and how the deposit is returned.
  • Pay only in ways you can trace. Requests for gift cards, crypto or wire transfers to strangers are common scam signs.
  • Be wary of a price far below similar rooms, or pressure to decide or pay right away.

These tips and the safety checks on each listing are reminders only. ShortStay does not verify hosts or identities and does not give legal advice.

    Users edit records and decisions. Date and rent checks calculate automatically. Host messages and reminders are manually triggered. All data is fictional and is not participant evidence.
